name: When should I consider replacing my bathroom vanity?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my bathroom vanity?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing your bathroom vanity if it shows significant signs of wear and tear, such as water damage, mold, peeling laminate, or broken drawers. Outdated styles that no longer match your aesthetic preferences or current home décor are also common reasons for replacement. Functionality issues like insufficient storage or a leaking sink are practical motivators. Additionally, a vanity replacement is an excellent upgrade during a bathroom renovation to improve overall value and usability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace your vanity if it has significant wear, water damage, or mold, if its style is outdated, or if it lacks functionality. It's also a key upgrade during a bathroom renovation.
